title: Agent Kallus
description: Alexsandr Kallus was dedicated in his service to the Empire and worked in the Imperial Security Bureau, chasing down Rebels across the galaxy. After a botched operation to trap the crew of the Ghost on Geonosis, Kallus was trapped on one of its frigid moons with a broken leg and his sworn enemy Garazeb Orrelios. When his enemy helped him rather than trying to kill him, Kallus began to rethink his priorities and defected to the Rebellion, becoming a valuable asset as Fulcrum.
